questions.q: Which are the three kinds of fields inside a CRM Analytics dataset?
questions.explain: Dimensions are grouped by, measures are aggregated, and dates can be bucketed by period.

questions.q: Which tool is dedicated to extracting Salesforce objects such as Opportunities, Accounts, and Users into CRM Analytics?
questions.explain: Data Sync extracts Salesforce object data. Other routes include connectors, CSV upload, and APIs.

questions.q: In a dataflow, what does the sfdcDigest action do?
options: Extracts fields from a Salesforce object
Saves the final result as a dataset
questions.explain: sfdcDigest is the extraction node. sfdcRegister is the node that registers the result as a dataset.

questions.q: In what format is a dataflow definition written?
questions.explain: A dataflow is a JSON definition of named nodes, each with an action and parameters.

questions.q: What does the lesson say about dataflows versus recipes today?
options: Dataflows are the only supported option
Recipes are unavailable in any org
Salesforce steers new work toward recipes and offers a way to convert dataflows, but many orgs still run dataflows, so check current documentation
Dataflows and recipes are identical products
questions.explain: Recipes are the recommended path for new work, while existing dataflows still need to be readable. Verify current status in documentation.
